# 2 Baruch Chapter 58 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "The second black waters that came from the sea after the first bright waters represent all the sins Israel committed during the time of Egyptian oppression."

**2** "The Egyptians forced them into labor, building their cities; they placed on them the yoke of slavery and crushed them with every form of oppression. These are the second black waters."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
